Name: Aurelia Vance, City Planner
Notes: Handles the paperwork after. Prefers a fortnight's notice. Has a stamp that says RETROACTIVELY PERMITTED and is not proud of it.

Name: Bartholomew Quill
Notes: Tailor. The only one who will quote for a hoodie in "adjustable" and mean it. Measures twice because the first one is always wrong by a storey.

Name: Coast Guard (Western Station)
Notes:
Written apology due the first of every month.
They have a folder. The folder has a name and the name is mine.
Ask for Petty Officer Hale; she files them without comment.

Name: Dr. Imogen Reyes
Notes: Still says "good boy". Has never once been wrong to. Bigger scales arrived in March; she was pleased.

Name: Ellery & Sons, Bakers
Notes: Pi Day supplier. Ate the bakery once, by arrangement, and paid for it. They ask every year. The answer is yes.

Name: Fennimore Ash
Notes: Macro too, though he insists forty feet is showing off. Good company. Terrible at parking.

Name: Grimsby Public Library
Notes: Three years overdue. One city overdue. They have stopped sending letters and started sending looks.

Name: Halden Voss
Notes: A certain billionaire. No longer answering. Was delicious. Would recommend, will repeat.

Name: Inspector Marla Deene
Notes: Turns up whenever a roof does not survive brunch. We are on first-name terms, which is worse.

Name: Jory Pike
Notes: Knows which rooftops hold weight. Charges in chips. Worth every chip.

Name: Kestrel Insurance (Claims)
Notes: They will not cover it. They have been very clear. I keep the number for the tone of voice.

Name: Lowell Tibb, Dentist
Notes: Got a bigger chair in. Sends a reminder every January and I go every January, which surprises us both.

Name: Mayor Oren Castellan
Notes: Meets me about the skyline. Has stopped saying "unprecedented". Frames the consultation drawings now.

Name: Nettle
Notes: Second of February. Checks a shadow, I check mine, the town gets an apology either way. Small. Not to be underestimated.

Name: Orrin Blakewood, Roofer
Notes: On retainer. Genuinely. He built the brunch roof twice and charged me once, which I have not forgotten.

Name: Perch Street Chippy
Notes: Family size means something different here. They have a wheelbarrow. They keep it for me.

Name: Quennell Frey
Notes: Cousin. Ordinary sized, which he brings up. Moult advice, tail advice, and no sympathy whatsoever.

Name: Rosalind Meech
Notes: Redraws the coastline after. Says it is job security. It is job security.

Name: Sable, Night Shift
Notes: International Cat Day rivalry, formally noted, mutually tolerated. Shares the chips. Does not share the wheelbarrow.

Name: Umbra Salvage Co.
Notes: Clears up after. Discreet. Their invoices say "site tidying" and we all agree that is what it was.

Name: Verity Ashgrove
Notes: Runs the drills. I am one of the drills. She waves.

Name: Wick & Daughter, Opticians
Notes: Cannot help. Have said so kindly, twice a year, for six years. I keep going. They keep being kind.

Name: Yannick Ord, Locksmith
Notes: Doors, mostly. Has never once asked how the last one ended up like that, which is why he is in here.

Name: Zephyr Mab (Aunt)
Address: The old house, up the coast
Notes: Rings at eight on Sundays. Asks about the moult, the job, and whether I am eating. Two out of three answers are fine.

Name: 11 Bell Court (Landlord)
Notes: Deposit conversation ongoing. Filed under the last tab, which is where everything awkward ends up.
